data.narrative:
Basecamp Research is a Series B biotech company founded by Oliver Vince and Glen Gowers that has raised $85M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 8 private peers in Biotech & Health at Series B/C stages—including Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), New Limit ($3.1B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M)—plus 3 public sector benchmarks (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $85M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.9x Series B-to-next-stage multiplier, implies a valuation of $162M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of revenue disclosure for the target. The wide spread between these methods reflects material heterogeneity within the peer set—particularly the $10.3B outlier—and the absence of disclosed financial metrics for Basecamp itself.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $137M (low) to $4.0B (high), with a median of $1.8B. This wide band reflects substantive uncertainty around Basecamp's revenue trajectory, IP defensibility, and clinical-stage risk relative to peers. Stage-progression yields the most conservative read; peer-median anchoring dominates the upper range. Further diligence on pipeline maturity and revenue run rate would materially narrow this band.
